title: TCD-016-C1 Explicit Model-Evolution Decision and Candidate Rewetting Contract Qualification

allowed_scope: define one explicit bounded rewetting model-evolution candidate
assess the candidate against B3Q01 Class F gates
create bounded contract-level synthetic oracles and evidence
record scientific nonclaims and residual uncertainty
issue a fail-closed scientific qualification disposition
forbidden_overlap: mutation of SQ01-SQ08 or MASSQ04 semantics

M0_indefinite_fail_closed_persistence.reason: It preserves mass but supplies no observable continuation-to-receiver lifecycle and would silently promote safety semantics into permanent model physics.

ordering: only then permit any runoff, infiltration, sorption-after-arrival, transformation or atmospheric-loss process that consumes surface aqueous NH4
M1_rewettable_surface_NH4_N_residue_equi.restart: Before activation restore exact M_cont. The candidate transfer is atomic; no checkpoint may expose a half-applied event. After transfer M_cont is zero and no hidden event memory exists.
M1_rewettable_surface_NH4_N_residue_equi.small_water_consequence: The full transfer can create a very large aqueous concentration when positive surface water is very small. SQ09 introduces no concentration floor, clipping, export threshold or tolerance; that numerical-policy surface belongs to TCD-016-E1.

M2_partial_or_finite_rate_remobilization.reason: Requires an invented fraction, rate coefficient, equilibrium constant or other parameter without provenance or validation evidence.

M3_direct_layer1_transfer.reason: Would bypass the receiver-neutral surface lifecycle and add unqualified infiltration-coupled release and soil receiver semantics.

M4_specific_salt_or_solid_identity.reason: SQ08 found no evidence supporting a specific material phase, counter-ion or molecular speciation.

M5_multi_receiver_split.reason: No current evidence supports receiver fractions or competing receiver kinetics.

scientific_rationale.basis: The candidate closes the otherwise undefined lifecycle with the least parameterized conservative internal transfer and keeps dry-period persistence unchanged.

authoritative_theory.basis: No pinned ANIMO theory or qualified material-identity evidence establishes that all continuation mass is a completely and instantaneously rewettable surface aqueous NH4 equivalent. Defining the functional identity does not convert that definition into authoritative physical theory.

relationship_to_preserved_b3_baseline.basis: The candidate is explicitly model evolution, not corrected historical behavior, and historical revision-53 behavior remains UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2.

calibration_and_parameter_implications.basis: No calibration constants, fractions, rates, thresholds or tolerances are introduced.

conservation_implications.basis: The event is an exact same-control-volume typed internal transfer with equal source loss and receiver gain.

validation_evidence_appropriate_to_proce.basis: Current evidence validates the defect, ownership and conservation envelope but contains no qualified observations or process-specific evidence that discriminates complete instantaneous remobilization from partial, delayed or alternative receiver behavior.

expected_changes_over_application_envelo.basis: The candidate declares exact state changes and the small-positive-water consequence, but no empirical application envelope is validated.

evidence_classification.external_literature_reason: SQ08 leaves the continuation material physically unidentified. Generic ammonium solubility or remobilization literature cannot establish that this model state is a specific material or that its entire mass follows the selected complete-transfer law without a qualified source-to-state mapping or discriminating observations.

residual_uncertainty: actual continuation material phase and molecular speciation
whether rewetting remobilization is complete, partial or delayed
whether the surface aqueous pool is the sole physically appropriate receiver
post-rewet behavior at very small positive surface water
unlock_evidence: Traceable theory or material evidence that maps the continuation owner to a rewettable material class strongly enough to justify the selected receiver and complete-transfer approximation.
Process-specific observations or a qualified experiment covering dry-down followed by rewetting and measuring retained NH4-N and its receiver/time course.
Validation evidence able to discriminate complete instantaneous remobilization from partial, delayed, direct-to-soil or transformed alternatives over a declared application envelope.
